## Change

Both CodeQL `init` and `analyze` moved from the exact v4.39.3 commit to exact v4.39.4 commit `1bd86f2fdb4b86187fa4059f16f31a3202acc9ea`. Official annotated tag object `e0462179768953fd6790193e15caaef674ff709e` dereferences to that commit. The unsigned tag provides no cryptographic signer assurance; none is claimed. The official changelog dated November 20, 2026 says v4.39.4 updates the default CodeQL bundle to 2.27.5.

The existing offline policy regression now extracts the complete workflow `uses:` inventory, requires the exact ordered checkout/init/analyze list and rejects any action reference that is not a full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit. Triggers, permissions, timeout, checkout boundary, language and query pack remained unchanged.
